scripts.build: rm -rf build && npx tsc && rm -f build/external/*.map && diff src/external/cctv.worker.js src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js -u >src/external/cctv.worker.diff
scripts.bundle: rm -rf build/final && npx esbuild src/main.ts --sourcemap=external --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=build/final/final.js && cd build/final && tar zcvf ../final.tar.gz . && zip -r ../final.zip .
scripts.sync-latest-worker: TMP=$(mktemp) && curl -qfsS https://player.cntv.cn/h5vod/cctv.worker.js | npx js-beautify -n >$TMP && if cmp "$TMP" src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js; then rm -f $TMP; else mv -f "$TMP" src/external/cctv.worker.orig.js && echo need to update cctv.worker.js; fi
